a.lede: If there's one issue that seems to activate all kinds of voters in 2026, it's data centers. The rapid buildout of these massive server storage facilities - and the infrastructure construction and expenses that come with them - has sparked local opposition in communities across the country and become a major issue in many congressional […]
a.title: Data center backlash is uniting America

b.lede: Amazon has ditched its plans to build four new data centers in Loudoun County, Northern Virginia, following an outcry from local residents and officials. The land will now be repurposed for mixed and residential use.
b.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia
